problem.notInServer: That user is not in the server.
problem.serverOwner: The server owner cannot be changed from here.
problem.yourself: You cannot change your own roles or timeout from here.
problem.aboveBot: {name} has a role at or above Mewvo's highest role, so Discord does not let the bot change them.
problem.aboveYou: {name} has a role at or above your highest role.
problem.everyone: The @everyone role cannot be given or taken.
problem.managed: @{role} is managed by an integration or bot; Discord does not allow changing it by hand.
problem.roleAboveBot: @{role} is not below Mewvo's highest role, so Discord does not let the bot give or take it.
problem.roleAboveYou: @{role} is not below your highest role.
problem.staffRole: @{role} has staff permissions ({permissions}); only the server owner or the bot owners can give or take it here.

skip.admin: has Administrator (Discord does not allow a timeout)
skip.guard: safety limit: no more bans/kicks allowed in this 10-minute window
